purpose: Qualify existing Windows test-engine timeout and official test-fixture path observations for correct issue routing; do not substitute source component passes for a report
constraints: No account/login/inference/authentication/global CLI or settings changes; unchanged production hooks; raw logs/source stay private

arms_in_fixed_order.selection: All original upstream tests in an unchanged private copy
All original tests; only the existing virtual git-directory matching expression is normalized for Windows
Same portable overlay, one original file per native invocation; byte-exact restoration
Entire original register.test.ts only, assertions/imports/shared helper unchanged
Same single original file; only existing path matcher normalization changed

fixture_path_hypothesis: Literal equality with /work/.git misses the native Windows normalized path, so the test's synthetic MERGE_HEAD is withheld. If current register-only runs fail the same three merge assertions while the one-expression control passes, classify as an upstream test-fixture portability defect, not a production merge failure.
timeout_hypothesis: Full-suite dispatch may outlast the native 5000 ms case deadline. Observe current full/serial controls independently of the deterministic path assertion failure; do not infer internal worker count or root cause from a passing serial run.
failure_and_invalidity: Keep configured timeout, test-timeout versus assertion and incomplete-command metadata separate. No hidden retry or deadline inflation. Unexpected failures require diagnosis; do not fit new success criteria after results.
publication_gate: A current upstream test-fixture defect may be reported accurately as that component, if minimal public reproduction, controls, duplicate search, privacy and independent case review pass. No model account is required for such a report. At most one new Anthropic issue, no production/core failure claim from fixture evidence.
search_and_review: Review official current bug/feature forms and related issue/PR/comments; search exact test names, matcher and CLI timeout terms. Zero search hits is not proof of novelty. Submit only after a reviewer who did not design this cycle examines draft/data/fixture.
registration: Protocol committed before native experiments; each source/overlay/protocol hash captured before invocation. Stage counts and deterministic repeats are not independent model trials.
